title: How to set image description reminder
description: If you find yourself forgetting to add image descriptions to your GIFs and images, you’re not alone. To help you remember, you can set a reminder that will tell you when image descriptions are missing. Then you can go back and add the descriptions before posting.

Under Media, the checkbox next to the image description reminder is checked. The description says: “Receive image description reminder. runs: Now, the next time you try to post a post with one or more images that are missing a description, you’ll get the reminder below.

blocks.alt: Screenshot of Add image description reminder. The reminder says: Don’t forget to make your image accessible. Good image descriptions are concise yet detailed. Be sure to summarize or write out any text in the image itself. Your description makes Twitter accessible to people with disabilities, and everyone who wants more context. You can turn off this reminder in Accessibility Settings. The two buttons say Add descriptions and Not this time.
